Rattus is a virtual rat in an operant chamber, for learning about classical and operant conditioning.

## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 | `Rattus_<version>_x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Rattus_<version>_x64_en-US.msi` |
| macOS 10.15+ (Intel and Apple silicon) | `Rattus_<version>_universal.dmg` |
| Linux | `Rattus_<version>_amd64.AppImage` (any distribution), `.deb` (Debian/Ubuntu) or `.rpm` (Fedora/openSUSE) |

The installers are not code-signed yet, so the system warns the first time you open Rattus:

- **Windows**: SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info** and then **Run anyway**.
- **macOS**: open the `.dmg`, drag Rattus to Applications, then right-click the app and choose **Open**. If macOS still refuses, go to **System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. If it says the app "is damaged", run `xattr -cr /Applications/Rattus.app` in Terminal.
- **Linux**: make the AppImage executable (`chmod +x Rattus_*.AppImage`) and run it, or install the package with `sudo apt install ./Rattus_*_amd64.deb`.

**Português:** baixe o instalador do seu sistema na lista abaixo. Como os instaladores ainda não são assinados, o Windows e o macOS mostram um aviso na primeira vez; siga as instruções acima.
